group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the helper family once in the group-local case_lib. For each transition/return witness select the left generated alternative, unfold the boundary dllseg, reject the impossible empty/nonempty case from node=stop facts, then either extend the processed prefix by snoc or close it with xizi_dll_close/xizi_dll_empty_rev. For entail_wit_2_1 derive the 32-bit non-wrap bound from owned aligned stores before rewriting unsigned_last_nbits; finish list partitions using the explicit invariant equalities and Zlength lemmas. Explicitly do not use derivable1_trans or sepcon_emp_logic_equiv'; compose spatial steps through sep_apply/sep_apply_l_atomic and proved suffixed helpers, and perform resource rearrangement with direct cancel blocks.
